components.name: Pagoda tier wall/post bay
components.function: Source has roof tile, lattice, bell and carved bracket motifs. Audit existing parked B06 surface sheet before generating any new surfaces. Likely needs stacked column/floor corner, roof ridge/hip and stair-plinth junction geometry; koi/dragonflies remain proposed habitat fauna. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated pagoda tier wall/post bay matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
